subject: AWS co-sell: HelixCare — ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixcare.com>, Carlos Martinez <carlos.martinez@amazon.com>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell: HelixCare — ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro

Hi Lena / Carlos / Priya,

Thanks for the time last week — excited to move this forward. We have a clear production use case from HelixCare (real‑time anonymized chart summarization for care coordination) and would like to get started on the AWS co‑sell path. High level asks:

- Kick off ACE registration so we can be eligible for co‑sell motions.
- Quick PDM/PSM intro so we can align on technical readiness and customer success plan.
- Capture a short mutual action plan (dates for demo, intake form submitted, security checklist).

Ive attached a filled ACE intake PDF that captures scope and expected ARR band. Karthik and Marissa are on the thread to coordinate the demo and technical fit.

Proposed next steps:
1) Carlos/Priya — confirm ACE contact and recommended timeline (we're aiming for an ACE submission by 6/21).
2) Lena — share procurement contact and any security questionnaire owners (cc'd procurement@helixcare.com if helpful).
3) Redwood — provide an MUP/MPA draft for commercial review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: helixcare-ace-intake.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixcare.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixcare.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: HelixCare — ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear plan. We're interested and the use case looks compelling. A few notes from our side:

- Procurement is looped (procurement@helixcare.com) — they will want a draft SOW and basic commercial terms.
- Security/compliance: our security team needs the SOC2 scoping and data flow diagram. Can you confirm data residency and whether any PHI touches Redwood systems?
- Demo: week of 6/28 works for our clinical stakeholders.

I'll coordinate on our end. Feel free to include specific examples (anonymized transcripts) for the demo.

-Lena
Director, Product — HelixCare

Hi all — Carlos here from the AWS PDM team. Thanks for the note, Irene. Happy to help move HelixCare into the ACE workflow. Quick context and what I need from you: 

1) ACE intake — please attach the completed intake form (Irene, I see one attached; I'll upload it to our intake portal).
2) PSM intro — Priya (copied) will be the PSM for this region and can help with enablement and the co‑sell plan.
3) Timeline — if you can target the intake upload by 6/21 and have a demo during the week of 6/28, we can aim for ACE acceptance in early July.

Priya, over to you for next steps on technical readiness and any customer onboarding playbooks.

Regards,
Carlos Martinez
Principal Partner Development Manager — AWS

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: HelixCare — ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro

Thanks Carlos / Priya / Lena — great to have everyone on the thread. Quick mutual action plan (MAP) — putting proposed owners and dates below: 

- 6/16: Redwood sends MUP/MPA draft for commercial review — owner: Marissa Cole (attached).
- 6/18: HelixCare security to confirm SOC2 scope / data residency notes — owner: Lena Ortiz.
- 6/21: ACE intake submitted to AWS portal — owner: Carlos Martinez (AWS).
- Week of 6/28: Demo for clinical stakeholders — owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — target 30–45m.
- Early July: ACE decision and co‑sell qualification — owner: AWS PDM.

Attachments included: redwood-mup-mpa-draft.docx (commercial draft), helixcare-ace-intake.pdf (completed intake).

Notes:
- On data residency: the HelixCare pipeline will keep PHI inside their VPC; Redwood will process de‑identified payloads by default. Karthik will follow up with a short diagram for the security team.
- For procurement: CC'd procurement contact is fine — Marissa will provide a line‑item estimate and T&Cs in the MPA.

Would like to lock a 6/29 09:00 PT demo slot — Karthik, Marissa, and Dylan can present a short technical walkthrough and cost/throughput profile. Carlos / Priya / Lena — confirm if that works or propose an alternate.

Thanks everyone — happy to hop on a quick call to finalize dates.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-mup-mpa-draft.docx (DOCX, 78KB)
